v1_human_g2_ac.ac_1: Given the user provides no existing events, when the meeting duration is 30 minutes on a Monday, then the earliest suggested slot is 09:00.
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_2: Given the user provides no existing events, when the meeting duration is 30 minutes on a Monday, then 09:00 is the last one
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_3: Given there is an event from 10:00 to 11:00, when the meeting duration is 30 minutes during 12:00, then suggested slots during 12:00 to 17:00
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_4: Given there is an event from 10:00 to 11:00, when the meeting duration is 30 minutes, then suggest 1 slot is 9:30 ending total
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_5: Given an event 07:00 to 08:00, when duration is 30min on Monday, then 07:00 is suggested

v1_human_g2_goal: The objective of the system is to Provide Valid Meeting Start times for a day respecting work hours on all existing events.
v1_human_g2_input: EVENTS = Start Time - end time ("HH:MM", "HH:MM") Valid values, MEETING_duration = int - minutes Positive int value, string at 3 char three letter day string
v1_human_g2_output: It returns a list of valid meeting start times as "HH:MM" strings, in ascending order. If none available, return empty list.
